options: ハルトの意識が再びクラウドへ戻る
紙の記憶に隠された第三者の手紙
意識が紙に刻まれ、逆に消える

en.title: The Lead-Colored City and Paper Memories
en.premise: In an era where consciousness is digitized as a norm, a woman arrives at my office clutching a handwritten letter. It is an analog will left by the dead, a map to truths that the digital realm can never reach. While wrapped in cigarette smoke, I begin chasing fragments of memories that should have vanished into the electronic sea.

zh.title: 铅色的城市与纸的记忆
zh.premise: 在意识数字化已成常态的时代，一位女子携手写信来到我的办公室。那是一份死者留下的模拟遗嘱，也是数字空间永远无法触及的真相之图。烟雾缭绕中，我开始追寻本应消失在电子海洋里的记忆碎片。
